changesOff: No change · your changes are off
noData: No data for this metric yet
copied: The world was copied at this moment. One copy runs on unchanged; the other gets the what-if. Same seed, so every difference comes from the change.
asIs: This run shows the world as it is, from the moment of export.
nothingNew: Nothing new happened in this stretch. Watch the numbers below.
nothingNewShort: Nothing new happened in this stretch.
captionRun: Same world, same seed ({seed}), same rules: run it yourself in What-If Lab.
storyMeta: From {from} to {to} · seed {seed} · made with What-If Lab (rule-based, no AI, no live data).
storyNoWhatIf: No what-if: this is the world as it is.

studio.open: Export video, pictures, text or slides
studio.title: Export studio
studio.whatVideo: A {s}-second clip: {start}, {run} seconds of {who} running from {span}{end}.
studio.whatImages: The title, key moments, the result, the chart alone and the stage alone, as full-size pictures.
studio.whatText: Subtitles timed to the video, a caption ready to post, and the whole story with every number.
studio.whatSlides: Title, setup, the what-if, three to four key moments and the outcome, from {span}.
studio.keepOpen: {note}. Keep this tab open while it records.
studio.noWhatIf: No what-if yet, so this shows the world as it is. Pick a what-if first to compare two futures.
studio.fromNow: This run starts from now, because the changes were edited after the fork.
studio.noVideo: This browser can't record video. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, or make pictures or slides.
studio.tryAll: Try every setting here. Downloading is part of Premium, $15 a year; every world and what-if stays free.

styles.title: My styles
styles.copied: Style copied. Paste it on another device.
styles.notStyle: That isn't a What-If Lab style.

errors.noRecord: This browser can't record video. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

preview.video: Preview of the video. Drag a text to move it; with a text picked, arrow keys nudge it.

ctl.theStageOnlyNo: The stage only, no text on it, for adding your own in an editor.
ctl.slowDownWhereThe: Slow down where the worlds differ
ctl.momentsOnlyOneWorld: Moments only one world had play at about half speed.
ctl.shadeTheStageBehind: Shade the stage behind the opening and result
ctl.title: Title
ctl.theBrightTickIs: The bright tick is now. Past it, both worlds keep running by the same rules. Dots mark moments only one world had.
ctl.orDragItOn: Or drag it on the preview.
ctl.hardToReadOn: Hard to read on this background. Try a shade behind it or another colour.
ctl.thisBrowserCanT: This browser can't change brightness, contrast or colour strength. Warmth and dark edges still work.

piece.label: World name tag
piece.cards: Shade behind the opening and result

ctl.narrationNote: Written from the run, timed to the video. Type over any line to change it; empty it to go back. The same lines go into the subtitles file.

intro.noneNote: No intro scene: the plain opening title shows instead (Text → Opening title).
intro.tooShort: Give the intro some time, or it won't show.
intro.fontsNote: Fonts come from Look → Title font and Body font.
intro.mineNote: Save this intro with its words, colour and length, and use it on any world. Kept in this browser.
intro.copied: Intro copied. Paste it on another device.
intro.notIntro: That isn't a What-If Lab intro.

sound.privacy: Sound stays on this device: nothing is uploaded, and it isn't kept when you close the studio.
sound.voiceNote: Press Record: the preview plays from the start while you talk over it. It stops by itself at the end.
sound.fileNote: A voice-over or music from your device (MP3, WAV, M4A). Use only sound you have the right to use.
sound.duck: Lower the file while your voice speaks
sound.noMic: No microphone, or it wasn't allowed. Allow the microphone for this site and try again.
sound.takeFailed: Couldn't keep that take. Try again.
sound.cantRead: Couldn't read that file. Try an MP3, WAV or M4A.
sound.unsupported: This browser can't add sound to a video. Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
sound.captionsNote: No time to record? Turn on Narration (Text tab) for lines on the video, or use the subtitles file with your app's own voice.
sound.silent: This browser recorded it without sound.

layerWhat.title: The question, while it runs
layerWhat.metric: The number that changed most, for both worlds
layerWhat.intro: Over the stage before it runs
layerWhat.outro: Over the stage at the end
layerWhat.captions: Lines along the bottom, timed to the run

introWhat.question: The what-if types on, word by word
introWhat.guess: Time to guess before it runs
introWhat.cinema: Black bars, the world's name, the title
introWhat.zoom: The stage grows to fill the frame
introWhat.thenNow: No change, then a wipe to the change
